content: Build your life through Wisdom, the foundation of wisdom will keep you from all the pitfalls in life. By wisdom I mean the wisdom of the Spirit of God revealed in the Word, not the function of man's thinking, the wisdom of man can only be acquired by experience, it is the wisdom of hindsight, it's knowing what you should have done in the past, but the wisdom of God is a foundation a secure future, it let's us know what to do in the now to be successful in the future yet to unfold. Get wisdom.

Don't be self conscious, God did not make us to be conscious of our individual needs, if you are constantly looking out for your own desires, the fervency of your faith will recede. Our faith in God is not just to work for ourselves, true Christianity is about your love for others, we all called to a life of compassion, to win the lost, to heal the sick, to care for those in need. As you look out for the needs of others yours are totally sort out in abundance.

To have gladness of heart is so important, Jesus came that you should experience Joy in your life. Joy is very serious business in Heaven, many have exchanged their joy for a false sense of happiness, they believe what God can give them will make them happy, while there are others who believe our relationship with God is all about being serious and stern, they believe that is holiness. The truth is in His presence there is fullness of Joy!!

One of the greatest losses one can ever suffer is the loss of hope, the loss of hope takes away ones strength in life, their ability to press on is severed. The reason why we can get up in the morning and press towards the future is because we know there is hope for a glorious future, the Light of God shines in the darkness. There is hope for your glorious life, it shall come to pass, hold on to hope.

Give yourself a chance, you've been holding back on that dream for so long, it's time to get it out of the box and actually work on it, you've been thinking about it for so long, this is the moment, step out into it and allow yourself to go for gold. When take a chance you'll find people and resources that will help you on your way will appear, that have just been waiting for you to take this direction. Take it up the cause today, it is worth it.

The concept of Grace is not against hard work, it is against toiling; that is working hard for so long with little or no productivity. Jesus came for free us for toil, that everything we put our hands to may prosper, toiling is part of the curse, it is a function of the fall of man, in Christ we have been redeemed for the curse and all its effects, now we can enjoy the fruit of our labor, and the joy of being productive. This is our heritage in Christ, we are Blessed!

The hand of God is upon the righteous, in all things it shall be well with them, they shall shine like the stars in the Heavens. Now it is really important to note that the righteousness that we speak of is that which comes from believing in Jesus and what He has done for you. The believers blessing is fully based on the reality of what Jesus has done for you, Faith receives what Grace has freely given, our peace is sure because it comes from an unshakable foundation, that is the finished work of Jesus Christ.

Focus on what you want your life to produce; what you constantly keep before your eyes is what your life will being producing. God made man with His eyes in front so that He may see where He is to go, therefore your life will always head in the direction that you set your eyes. See the future you desire, set God's word ever before you and watch your life head there.

A believer is not just a person with a strong moral code, or a benevolent person, full of good deeds. Nothing could be further from the truth, a believer is someone who has the very life of God in them, one who is a citizen of Heaven, a legal representation of the Godhead on Earth, with the full backing of Heaven, an ordained conduit of the plans and purposes of God on the Earth. This is what God has made you in Christ, live and act accordingly!

The Faithfulness of the Lord towards you is not dependent on what you have done, it is dependent on His Word and who He is, He is faithful that's His nature. You can stake your life on the reality of this truth. Faith should be founded in this unshakable truth, this is who God has revealed Himself to be, Enjoy His faithfulness.

Find pleasure in serving God by serving others, Jesus came not to be served but to serve, and before He left, He told His disciples that as the Father sent Him, He also was sending them. We are called to serve; right at the helm of Christianity is the heart of service to mankind, we are here to express God's heart for people, to be a blessing, to love and lift people up, to give hope and joy in a broken world. We are His hands and feet!

What you have seen so far is not the final or the best that the Lord will do in your life. Many people get stuck in the past trying to relive the "glory days" over and over, this at times could be the very thing that keeps you from moving on to higher heights and encounters with the Lord! God has more in store for you, than you can even imagine! Greater Miracles are just ahead!

To really succeed in life and make impact, you must really believe in who God has made you to be. Everything about you is just right, what you see as inability is nothing but you comparing yourself with another. God loaded you with all that you need to fulfil your destiny in life, His grace is sufficient for you. Be you and do you!

God desires to make your name great, so many people are out there trying so much to make their own name great, but the greatness of a name is from the Lord; this is more than just being famous it is making you an institution of blessing that anyone who connects him or herself to you is automatically blessed, just as it was with Abraham!

The Lord has His hand on you, He loves you with an everlasting love, you cannot be defeated or put to shame, He has gone before you and He fights for you. He is unfailing and unchanging and He wants you to know that He is ever with you, don't lose sight of His word, Everything He has promised you shall come to pass. You are destined to win!

When the Lord says don't be anxious for anything, He is telling you that when you are anxious you take that thing out of His hands and put it into your own strength! Trusting God allows Him to take care of your affairs, you cannot both work on the same thing, it's either it's in your hand or it's in His! This is not being irresponsible but rather it is understanding that your life is His responsibility, because He is your Lord!

Let go of the struggle, if you are struggling with something, then you are going about it wrongly. Life was designed to function by certain stimulus, to get rid of or fix something, all you have to do is lay hold of the knowledge pertaining to that very thing. This is why we need to read the manufacturers manual to know how to go about life. There is no need to go about life by chance, There are specific fail proof ways that the Lord gives us in His Word!

This is the day that the Lord has made, it's yours for the taking, lay hold of the day, capture it, make progress today in the direction of your destiny, press towards the goal and the upward call of God on your life! Do not be passive about your life, live it today, make your life count, many people are depending on it!

The human mind cannot manufacturer Joy, Joy is a product of the recreated human spirit, when the Holy Spirit comes upon ones life, they become a place where joy can be made manifest. Joy has nothing to do with what is happening around you, it is not a product of circumstance, it's a matter of what is happening inside you. Let the joy of the Lord well up from inside you.

What is your God reality? What truth about God are you experiencing and manifesting in your life! Have you come to the divine place of fellowship with the God you have heard about for years? Don't accept to go about in life without experiencing higher heights and deeper depths in God, there is so much that awaits those who desire a greater encounter. Press in for more!

Don't hold back, the glory of the Lord is within you and it will manifest as you step out into life with a strong resolve to make impact in the world. The Christian life is to be lived out with courage, it is not for the faint of heart, God has made us more than conquerors, He has given us victory over all the wiles of the devil, His charge to us now is to go and take over the territory that is ours in Christ!

Favor doesn't follow the strength or skill of a man, God will bless you inspite of you. Your part is to step into the path of favor, by accepting the purpose's of God for your life. Every purpose of God carry's favor that will set you apart from all the those around you, much more it will cause others to do you good without a cause, people will feel obliged to bless you!

The worst state of a man is to be outside Christ, whether the man is wealthy, healthy or has some state of virtue in his or her life. True life and bliss is only found in Christ, that is true security, this is not to say that we only have hope for the sweet by and by, the power of our life in Christ is relevant in the here and now! Rejoice in your relationship with Christ, you have the best part of life, you have access to the divine experience and reality of Perfection!

You don't have to go about life alone. The concept that God helps those who help themselves is a lie from hell, we couldn't help ourselves out of the sin nature, but the Father Loved us and sent His son to die for us to get us out, now that we are in Christ His Love for you hasn't changed, He will help you out of all that ails you! Seize the toil He comes to give you rest!

The heights of Christianity are not found in the demonstration of the Power of God, rather the demonstration of power is a result of walking in the heights of Christianity. As you walk closer with the Lord in your upward call you'll find that Love is the greatest, Love is the highest calling that the believer, it is the only way to express the fullness of God! Answer to the call of Love!

You are special, in Almighty God's divine plan there is a special place where only you fit. Don't despise who you are and where you are at, you were born into the right family, at the right time, it may not look like what you think as a better life for yourself, but on this journey to where the Lord is taking you, bless and inspire others every step of the way, maximize your impact where you are right now, be a blessing every where and at every stage.

Have a firm grip on the reins of your life, don't let life just happen to you make the changes you desire, go to the places you desire; don't just find yourself in a situation. If indeed you are at a place because of circumstances beyond your control, there is power beyond the circumstances that can bring things back in alignment with your destiny. The Holy Spirit is our Great Helper, He is here to lead you to walk in the path set before you, trust Him and His power!

The joy of giving out weighs that of receiving, God brought you to Earth not to be a receiver but to be a giver, seek out your designed opportunity to give, to love, to share and to bless, and as we all live this way so much the ails humanity will simply disappear, there is no place for selfishness in the world, it was designed by and for Love! Share the love in you today!

The Glory of Creation is in it fulfilling it's divine purpose, every created thing serves a purpose in the eternal plan of God! There is a place for you in existence and it is a place of your highest potential and impact and place of the fullness of the Glory of your life, this is the position of maximum fulfilment and satisfaction! It is only in God that a man of completely successful, take your place in Christ today!

There is a concept that says that Gospel is only for the poor and needy, well that has kept the church from bring relevant to great portion of society. Jesus is for everyone, The Gospel is relevant to whole spectrum of humanity, every race and class. So go forth sit and every table before Jesus interacts with everyone, this makes you acceptable to all, Go to the broken, go to those who have it all together!

Joy is Kingdom business, there is no Christianity apart from Joy, from the moment one gets saved they are filled with the Joy of Salvation, and from then on Joy becomes the hallmark of their lives. The recreated human spirit produces Joy, it is a manifestation of the Holy Spirit in one life. It's with Jesus joy that we walk out the Christian life, all day every day!

A hardened heart will keep you away from God's best. A hardened heart comes about when one constantly refuses to accept the truth of the Word of God, over time the heart becomes callused to the Truth, and in the moments when you need that word to work for you, it may not manifest! Keep your heart constantly open to the Word, receive God's Word today!

The hope for a better life is not out there somewhere in the world, all that you need is already inside you, you are carrying the very resource and capacity you need for a complete turn around. No economy was designed to prosper you, you are prosperous from within, your success comes as you apply yourself to life and manifest your destiny.

They say hindsight is 2020, meaning you can only see the past clearly, but to live such a life would be meaningless and full of regrets, you are not called to live in the past, we live in the present and live out the future. Therefore our vision of where we are and where we are going should be clear. God desires is to live with the knowledge of the future, to see clearly where we are going, His Word lights up our path.

God is not looking for servants, the Fathers heart desires son's. Our relationship with Jesus Christ is not all about service to Him, but rather it's about companionship, it culminates in His dreams becoming ours, where God's desire manifest through us and we are in total agreement as co-laborers with Him. This is the place where His will becomes ours, this is what creation is waiting for!

Salvation is not the end, it's is the foundation of the Life God desires to give us in Christ, Salvation is actually the beginning of the journey, it is the bedrock upon which the Lord manifests He plan and purposes through us. Jesus did not only die and resurrect for us to be saved and go to Heaven, rather He came to make life available to us.

Prayer does not generate power, the source of power in a Christians life is the person of the Holy Spirit, our times of prayer are moments where the Power that we have is distributed to every area of our lives and that of those around us. We don't pray to get power, we already have all the potency of the Godhead resident in us! Use this knowledge as you pray and command the changes that you desire.

The first person God calls you to be is yourself, you cannot be used outside who you are, God doesn't need you to become someone else, He only uses originals, be the first and only you, you may receive inspiration from external sources but your call is to be yourself. When God met Moses He asked him what was in his hand, and through Moses' staff God did wonders; what do you have in your hand, that's what the Lord will use to shake the World!

There is no weakness in humility, in fact it takes the strongest of wills to be humble! Meekness is power under control, it is the ability to exercise great self control and discipline. True Humility is the out working of the Holy Spirit in one life, it is the manifestation of one's recreated human spirit. There is always a place at the top for the humble, there is a provision of Grace for them. Walk in Humility!

You are better off holding on to the word of God, despite what the situation looks like. The Word is not a last resort, He has prime place in our lives, all that is available to us is what is we have received from the Word of God! Who you are is so much dependent of the reality of the Word that you have allowed to frame your world! We are a people of the Word!

Own your life's work, take responsibility of what God has entrusted to you. Use your hands to build great things that will shape the future and define the human experience. You were not created to live a dim life, it's time to shine, it's time to soar above norms and traditions, you were created for so much more, it's your moment, the stage is yours... Take it!

Many people read through the Gospels and are amazed by the life that Jesus lived, they say "oh what it would have been like to have been born in those days". Well the truth is, by the Holy Spirit we have a better experience than the people who walked with Jesus in His day. We have the person Holy Spirit permanently residing in us. He is the one who makes Jesus real and manifest to us. Walk in the reality of Christ!

Grace is not a product of a man's hard work, it is a function the finished work of Jesus Christ in His death, burial and resurrection. When Grace comes upon a man it sets him apart and causes exploits to be wrought by his hands apart from his strength, will or intellect. Grace is God's ability to work in you and through you inspite of you. Walk out the Grace of God in your life!

Sometimes the discomfort we feel is not of an evil origin, it might just be that you have out grown your comfort zone. You no longer fit in the space that you once called home. The Lord has something new for you, but you have to let go of the old so that you may walk into the experience of this new life that's yours in Christ! Choose purpose over comfort!

What you have is enough to get you out of where you are, sometimes people feel like what they need for their next level is way out there, but the truth is look inside, you'll find when you add value to what is already inside you, it will open you up to a whole new world of opportunity! No one will recognize what you don't see in yourself, your gifts and abilities should be seen and acknowledged by you, before anyone else.

The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, this is a very powerful reality that many of God's people need to acknowledge, there is never a time that you have to try to get His attention, His eyes are ever in you. Many are so sure that God sees all the wrong things they may do, but they feel He has to be reminded of their righteous deeds. But this is not the case, God is not unjust, He sees you and know all that concerns you, let you prays be filled with thanks and praise for all that He is to you.

The angels of God were created to carry out His purposes on the Earth, there is so much that happens in our lives through angelic agency. Have you acknowledged them in your life. They have a huge role to play in your, career, academics, relationships etc. Many people are so aware of the work of demons and evil spirits, yet they have little to no information of the Angelic aid that is available to them. Acknowledge them today.

The Gospel is only to get people converted to Christianity, the truth is it is more accurate to call it translation from darkness into light. The Gospel once believed brings the person out of darkness into the kingdom of Light. Even after one is in Christ there is need to be taught the truth and power of the gospel to remove them from any area when darkness may still be prevalent. Jesus said "he who follows me shall not walk in darkness" there is no place for darkness in your life.

If you see more of your mistakes than the grace of God, you are being too self conscious, feelings of shame are a clear sign that you have taken your eyes off Jesus and on to yourself, never be confident in your know ability and righteousness. Functioning in Grace is to keep Jesus and all that He has done for you as your focus, and to live in the benefit of His death, burial and resurrection.

What is past is never greater than what is to come, don't spend your life looking back, there are greater things ahead, come to the revelation of all that's yours in Christ, hold on to what He has prepared for you as you walk this path of life. You are going from glory to glory, the grace of God is never stagnant or retrogressive, we are always taken higher and higher!
